e: From rofe- (of unknown origin) + -coxib (“selective cyclo-oxygenase inhibitor”).

q: Roflurane does not react with metals such as steel, nickel, copper, and aluminum […] and inhibits the reaction of haloalkanes with aluminum […]

e: From ROFL, Internet abbreviation for "rolling on the floor laughing".
q: 2002, Tim Byron, “i dedicate this to the sheepsticks.”, in alt.music.radiohead (Usenet):
Just finished roffling at today's 'oh lucky you'.....mirth aplenty!
I wondered if someone watching might consider that a 'plan' and feel compelled to, well, build a fence. My own reaction was to roffle and say, "Now ain't that a woman".
